## Verification

List checks that prove the outcome, including a negative or boundary case where relevant.

- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behavior
- [ ] Public API, Agent Card, event, and persistence contracts are unchanged or explicitly versioned
- [ ] New features include unit, contract, and integration coverage at the applicable boundaries
- [ ] Helm/Argo CD impact reviewed, or not applicable
- [ ] Documentation and release notes updated, or not applicable
- [ ] No credentials, private payloads, or generated evidence committed
